Print with your M110

Connect by USB and install the Phomemo printer driver. Set the same label dimensions here and in the printer settings. Use 100% / actual size, no margins, and turn off headers and footers. Print one label first and scan it before a full batch.

On mobile, download a label PNG and import it as an image in Print Master. Match the paper size and avoid cropping. This website does not pair directly over Bluetooth. “Print / PDF” also lets you save one label per PDF page.
